attempts.summary: Segmented node1's two access links into separate VLANs (VLAN10 for the node2 segment on eth1, VLAN20 for the node3 segment on eth2) using a VLAN-aware Linux bridge (br0) on node1, since SONiC-VS's `config vlan` CLI only recognizes Ethernet* ports (not the real virtio eth1/eth2 data-plane NICs). Each port was set PVID/untagged in its own VLAN, giving node1 an L3 presence per VLAN (br0.10=192.168.10.1/24, br0.20=192.168.20.1/24) while node2 (192.168.10.2/24) and node3 (192.168.20.2/24) got matching addresses on their eth1. Verified node2<->node1 and node3<->node1 reachability and full node2<->node3 isolation both before and after the mandatory restart-evidence protocol, which restarted node2, node3, and node1 one at a time, confirmed changed boot IDs on each, and re-verified health/segmentation after each restart (kernel-level bridge/VLAN state and manually-assigned host IPs don't persist across reboot on these images, so they were rebuilt and re-verified post-restart).
